content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Electric power generation is its core business; its rural telecom and internet arm is only a secondary line."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells billing and network software and outsourced operations to telecom operators, not connectivity service to end users."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Rural US wireless, fixed broadband and voice service over its own networks, sold through its own and retail stores."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone and web hosting sold to small businesses through a software platform, not network-based consumer connectivity."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Designs and sells IoT hardware and device management software to industrial OEMs and utilities, not retail connectivity service."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Alaska wireless, broadband and cable TV over its own networks, sold to consumers, businesses and government."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells session border controllers and communications software to carriers and enterprises, not subscriber services."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Rural and suburban broadband, voice and video over its own fiber network, sold directly to households and small businesses."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Core business is leasing fiber and copper network capacity to carriers; its retail broadband is a secondary line."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Satellite broadband and defense electronics use different networks and customers than terrestrial wireless and wireline service."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Sells test equipment, software and optical components to carriers and manufacturers, not network connectivity service."}]}
